title: Scheduled recheck, 4 Oct 2026 13:15 (weekly pass 2026-W40 plus 2 withheld grades)
scope: Weekly backstop for 2026-W40 together with the 2 queued withheld grades (khaimera/offlane, scarlett/offlane), against the live bundles published 2026-10-04T17:42:23+00:00 (tool 2.49.0; collection of 4 Oct 08:36-08:58 CDT, Pred.gg 1.17 + Hotfix 1.17.1 on all six ranks). Every withheld Gold+ grade and every inactive plan on any rank was checked. Not a full review.
standard: docs/RECHECK-RUNNER.md with the 2.34 / 27 Sep grade standard: a grade moves one step at most, a move needs a kit or patch reason plus evidence the same way, a drop without a kit reason needs the whole-line 95% interval to exclude the previous-patch review rate (at least 500 games, later games the same way), and a high rate alone never raises a grade.

evidence.statistics: Pred.gg ranked, versions 167 and 168, status ok on all six ranks

entries.reason: C retained. The engine withheld the grade for 'Statistics moved since review': the entry still cited the 1.16.4 Gold+ offlane sample (47.1% over 766), and the whole 1.17 line (versions 167 and 168) is now 50.2% over 594 [46.2, 54.2]. That interval includes the 47.1% 1.16.4 review rate. The official 1.17 notes and Hotfix 1.17.1 change nothing in Khaimera's kit (the 2.34 review found the Passive text only reformatted; his last listed changes are 1.16.4 bug fixes and the Invigorate multiplier, all before that review). With no kit or patch reason, a higher rate alone cannot raise the grade (2.34 / 27 Sep standard). Bronze+ is 51.2% over 1188 (nested, so not independent). The watch text no longer calls the 1.17 offlane sample small, and states why the grade stays. The reference sample is rebased to the whole 1.17 line.
entries.limitation: 594 games, interval about plus or minus 4 points. The 2.34 review's own 1.17 sample was only 51 games, so a 'since review' split is not meaningful here. If the line holds near 50% with more games, a later review could weigh whether C undersells him; that needs a kit or patch reason under the standard. No in-game test.

review_117_sample.note: 2.34 ledger: 1.17 Gold+ at review, version 167, fetched 2026-09-23 21:27 CDT.

entries.reason: A retained. The engine withheld the grade for 'Statistics moved since review': the early 1.17 sample at review (54.7% over 362) fell back, and the whole 1.17 line is now 51.6% over 3997 [50.0, 53.1]; the 3635 games since review ran 51.3%. The interval excludes that early 362-game rate, but the drop rule (27 Sep standard) applies when the interval excludes the previous-patch review rate, which is 52.2% over 5430 (1.16.4 Gold+, 2.34 ledger), and 52.2% lies inside [50.0, 53.1]. This is the Shinbi precedent of 27 Sep (early high rate faded back to the 1.16.4 level, A retained). No official 1.17 or Hotfix 1.17.1 change to Scarlett's kit (2.34: only the Swan Song in-place Blink reliability fix). Her rate and lower bound now sit level with the other A offlaners in the same bundle (Greystone 51.4% over 5883, Grux 51.6% over 4707), which still fits A. Bronze+ 50.6% over 9603 is nested. The watch text no longer calls her results 'strong'; the reference sample is rebased to the whole 1.17 line.
entries.limitation: 'Since review' is a derived difference and assumes the 362 review games sit inside the whole line. The lower bound is 50.04, so a further fall could bring the 1.16.4 rate outside the interval; the Ashen Vow base-damage field stays disputed. No in-game test.

since_review.note: Difference between the whole-line sample and the review sample; assumes the review sample is contained in the whole line.
